claims.statement: In 221 BCE, Qin’s conquests established a unified empire under the First Emperor. This marks a change in government across the conquered states, rather than the beginning of Chinese history.
Qin unifies the competing states: 221 BCE to 221 BCE. Year follows UNESCO. Unification refers to the contemporary competing states, not the borders of modern China.
